summary: Tested the 4 new features plus regression. Backend: 42/42 pytest pass. test_piggery_mqtt.py was extended with 23 new tests: set_mode/set_vent validation (10 cases), manual vent moves gradually toward the target and auto overrides it, usage/daily, CSV export (BOM, ';' separators, comma decimals, % closed columns, 404), broker validation (6 cases) and reconnect. The first run had 3 failures. All 3 came from latency on the public HiveMQ broker (1-4s each way, delivery is bursty), not from code bugs, and pass once the timeouts are 20-40s. Frontend at 390x844, all working: AUTO/RĘCZNY toggle and badge; sliders appear only in manual mode; keyboard (Home) and mouse drag on the sliders send set_vent; gauge chamber-0-curtain-left-value moved 89->47% at about 3%/s toward slider 0%; mode buttons are disabled when the chamber is off; daily-usage shows 7 bars in each chart (only today is non-zero); csv-range buttons update the href (chamber & hours) and the real download gives komora3_24h_*.csv; broker form fields are prefilled; port 0 shows a client-side toast with no PUT sent; host 'bad host' shows a 'Nie udało się zapisać' toast; a valid save shows the success toast and the device is back online in about 6s; EN labels are correct; no page errors. No horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: The request takes about 6.7s. mqtt_stop() calls loop_stop() before disconnect(), so the DISCONNECT packet is never sent cleanly and the call blocks. Calling disconnect() first and then loop_stop() would make it faster and cleaner.

The 5s online window is tight for the public HiveMQ broker. Observed state-delivery gaps were up to about 4s, and a set_mode round trip took up to about 6s. Status may flicker to offline, and commands can look ignored for several seconds.
Timestamps use the server's local timezone (.astimezone(), which is UTC in the container), not the user's timezone. Consider Europe/Warsaw or putting UTC in the column header.
The broker password is stored in plain text in Mongo (broker_config).

issues: At 390px the device_id input (1fr column) cuts off 'chlodnia-01'
An invalid host, prefix or port shows the generic 'Wpisz poprawne liczby' (enter valid numbers) toast, which is misleading for a text field such as an empty host
The TLS checkbox is a native input, not a shadcn Switch or Checkbox. Ticking TLS (8883) does not suggest port 8883.

action_items: Optional: in Gateway/PiggerySimulator.mqtt_stop call disconnect() before loop_stop() to speed up PUT /api/broker
Optional: widen the is_online window (for example to 10s) because of public broker latency
Optional: field-specific validation toast in BrokerForm; widen the device_id input on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: set_vent in AUTO mode silently updates ch.manual targets. Switching to manual then overwrites them with the current positions, so the stored value is unused. This is harmless.

The gateway subscribes to the wildcard '{prefix}/+/state' while latest_state is a single object. If another device publishes under the same prefix, the dashboard would mix states. Consider subscribing only to state_topic(DEVICE_ID).
set_broker restarts the in-process simulator too. This is fine for the demo, but with a real PLC the simulator should be disabled.
seed_data_creation: None. Restored state: all chambers mode auto; thresholds 26/3000, 28/3000, 30/3000; setpoints 20/22/24; chamber 3 OFF; simulator ON; broker broker.hivemq.com:1883, prefix emgt-fatek-7f3a9c, device chlodnia-01, no auth/TLS (verified via /api/config and /api/health)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel runs break the stateful tests) and export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first. The public HiveMQ broker adds 1-4s latency, so wait_for defaults to 20s. Editing files under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn reload, so wait about 8s afterwards. Slider thumbs are '[data-testid=chamber-X-slider-*] [role=slider]' (keyboard Home/End work). Recharts bars are '.recharts-bar-rectangle'.
